text:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall (severity: high) — elevated 5xx spike on inference-gateway across us-west-2, automated alert at 11:03 UTC. root cause suspected: recent LB/Envoy route config rollout.

oncall-elena: acked. I'm looking at grafana now.

raj_sre: grafana: upstream 5xx rate from gateway -> model-pool jumped from 0.8% to 12% at 11:03. P95 latency jumped too. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/ABC123

mike_net: seeing Envoy admin stats on one gateway pod: `upstream_rq_5xx: 2145` and `cluster.model-pool.upstream_cx_active: 380` — connections are pegged.

kira_prod: chrome logs from client side show repeated retries, many requests returning 502. Might be retry amplification.

oncall-elena: timeline: at 10:56 a config push rolled new route weights + retry policy (PR #5321). suspect retry policy too aggressive + circuit breaker thresholds too low -> overload -> 5xx.

raj_sre: checking envoy runtime: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/stats | grep upstream_rq_5xx` -> `cluster.model-pool.upstream_rq_5xx: 2145` and `cluster.model-pool.upstream_rq_502: 1892`. also `cluster.model-pool.upstream_rq_retry: 10400` (lots of retries).

mike_net: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T11:03:12Z] upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T11:03:12Z] upstream request retrying (attempt 2)
[2026-03-15T11:03:13Z] upstream request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
```

ashley_sre: quick hit mitigation suggestions: 1) disable retries at gateway runtime 2) increase circuit_breakers for model-pool or reduce outlier detection sensitivity 3) shift traffic off the overloaded route (weight -> 0) to fallback pool.

oncall-elena: attempting mitigation 1 now — disabling retries in runtime for route. Command: `kubectl -n infra exec deploy/gateway -- curl -s -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:9901/runtime_modify?retries_enabled=false"`

raj_sre: on prod-edge pod `gateway-3` ran: `curl -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:9901/runtime_modify' -d '{"retries_enabled":false}'` -> 200 OK.

kira_prod: immediately seeing drop in downstream retry counter. upstream_rq_retry decreased ~90% within 30s. 5xx rate trending down from 12% -> 4.8%.

pm_jeff: customers: support queue shows two major customers reporting increased errors in embeddings and chat generation. CS notified and are sending templated update. Impact window estimated ~11:03-11:20 UTC.

mike_net: next mitigation — rolling route weight change to divert traffic from model-pool to fallback-pool. Applying temporary weight 0. Command:`kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: envoy-route-override
data:
  route.json: |
    {"virtual_hosts": [{"routes": [{"match": {"prefix": "/v1/complete"},"route": {"weighted_clusters": {"clusters": [{"name": "model-pool","weight": 0},{"name": "fallback-pool","weight": 100}]}}}] }]}
EOF`

raj_sre: applied. traffic shift in progress. monitoring for any customer errors due to fallback model mismatch.

ashley_sre: also raising `circuit_breakers.max_requests` for model-pool to 5000 to avoid fast failovers: patching envoy cluster config via the control plane (hot restart not required for runtime changes).

oncall-elena: running synthetic check: `curl -v https://gateway.prod/v1/complete -H 'x-api-key: REDACTED'` -> before mitigation: 502, after retry disable: 200 (but latency up). After weight shift: 200 and p95 back to acceptable.

pm_jeff: CS note drafted: "We've mitigated an elevated error rate caused by a recent routing + retry config change. We disabled gateway retries and shifted traffic to a fallback pool. Errors have reduced and we're monitoring. If you experienced failures between 11:03–11:20 UTC please reopen the ticket."

mike_net: alerting: marked incident acknowledged, silenced noisy alerts for this route while we stabilize.

ashley_sre: next steps / action items: 1) rollback PR #5321 and re-evaluate retry policy + cluster circuit_breaker defaults. 2) run load tests against model-pool with current retry settings to reproduce amplification. 3) add runtime guard for retries (e.g., per-route runtime key defaulted to false). 4) postmortem owner: ashley_sre, due EOD.

oncall-elena: handing off to ashley for post-incident. I'll remain on standby for rollback help.

ashley_sre: accepted. assigning postmortem and linking todos. thanks @elena and team. Closing paging loop once graphs stable for 15m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update — mitigated at 11:12 UTC, monitoring. Resolution checklist started.

raj_sre: last check: 5xx rate now 0.7%, upstream retry metrics near zero, p95 latency recovering.

pm_jeff: notifying a couple impacted customers directly with follow-up.

ashley_sre: filing RCA draft: root cause = aggressive retry + recent route weight/config rollout; contributing = circuit_breaker thresholds too low and insufficient runtime guard. Remediation planned in PR #5336.

oncall-elena: thanks all — excellent triage.
